item.title: National Grid warns customers of scammers demanding immediate payment
item.description: ALBANY, N.Y (WNYT)- National Grid is urging customers to be cautious of scammers posing as company representatives. The company advises customers to always ask for identification if contacted by someone claiming to be from National Grid. Scammers often threaten service shutoff without notice or demand immediate payment through unconventional methods like wire transfers or prepaid cards.
